clips.title: The story
paras: At the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, William Pestle gathers supplies for Stormwind's apothecary. He and his brother Morgan run the shop in the Trade District, and William hires travelers to find candles, kelp, and herbs.

William works from Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn while his brother Morgan Pestle tends the counter at Pestle's Apothecary in Stormwind City's Trade District. From Elwynn Forest, William works with local gatherers to secure raw materials the city shops need. He sends regular shipments to the capital, where Stormwind's citizens rely on a steady supply of restorative salves, draughts, and powders.

William often needs more than common garden herbs for his craft. He hires newcomers to gather wax candles carried by Elwynn's kobolds and crystal kelp from the murlocs of Crystal Lake, just east of Goldshire. The ingredients may seem strange to those unfamiliar with alchemy, but William believes they have potent virtues in a mixture.
